title: Deep learning-driven anomaly detection and feature discovery in Ce-rich (Ni–Fe–Co–Ce)Ox catalysts for oxygen evolution reaction
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27117-27125
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02168A, Paper
Open Access

Chih-Yang Cheng, Yi-Huan Wu, Feng-Yin Li
VisOut, a deep learning framework, autonomously identifies high-performance Ce-rich OER catalysts from noisy datasets. Isolating specific optimal compositional windows accelerates data-driven discovery of unconventional electrocatalysts.
